name: @workspace/tool-logic-sql-format
description: The SQL Formatter tool's logic (D14, docs/tools/specs/sql-format.md): the dialects and options, the unclosed-comment check, the library's errors in words, the dialect hint, detectSql, the token check that formatting never changes the query, and formatting with sql-formatter (called from the tool's workers only). Pure TypeScript: no React, no DOM, no chrome.
